svg.title: Control plane / data plane separation
svg.desc: Account administrators call the Config API, which routes to one authoritative Durable Object per account. Account objects publish small configuration to KV Instant and larger blobs to KV or R2 with optional Workers Cache. The data plane has separate stateless Workers and stateful resource Durable Objects, with separate arrows from end users to both groups. KV Instant configuration flows to the Workers group; blobs flow to the resource objects. No direct calls or writes go from the data plane to the control plane in this pattern. Data-plane usage events flow to Pipelines, then R2 with Basin, then a scheduled job. The job calls the Config API. KV Instant is a private beta; no instantaneous-replication guarantee or per-object throughput is asserted.

g.text: The planes do not call each other directly in this pattern. Configuration flows through propagation layers.
No writes back. No direct calls in this pattern.
Writes flow one way: control → propagation → data
End users only hit the data plane
Stateless work on Workers; stateful work on Durable Objects
